irac.issue: Whether the bar under Order II Rule 2 of the CPC applies to the present suit, and whether the decree in O.S. No. 36 of 1963 constitutes res judicata or estoppel by conduct.
irac.rule: The cardinal requirement for application of the provisions contained in Order 2 Rules 2(2) and (3) is that the cause of action in the later suit must be the same as in the first suit.
irac.application: The court found that the cause of action in O.S. No. 36 of 1963 and O.S. No. 89 of 1983 were not the same, and therefore, the bar under Order II Rule 2 of the CPC does not apply. The court also found that the decree in O.S. No. 36 of 1963 did not constitute res judicata or estoppel by conduct.
irac.conclusion: The court held that the bar under Order II Rule 2 of the CPC does not apply to the present suit, and the decree in O.S. No. 36 of 1963 does not constitute res judicata or estoppel by conduct.
